description: An https:// origin redirects to http://. Refused unconditionally, and refused BEFORE the downgraded hop is issued (requests=1). A redirect that drops the transport is indistinguishable from an active downgrade attack, and a freshness signal read over a downgraded connection is evidence of nothing. This fixture sets allow_plaintext_http=true to prove the refusal is not gated on that flag: the flag exists so a loopback fixture can be addressed directly, not so a remote origin can walk the probe off TLS.
